06 / 06 Concept study

M&M Cleaning

Cleaning services

Care that reveals the space.

02 The opportunity

Show the result of a service that usually goes unseen: the space cared for, layer by layer.

03 The direction

Composition
A room in cross-section, like a scale model, with space around it for the text.
Typography
Plus Jakarta Sans, with short, direct headings.
Colour
Navy and white, with a cyan trail in the details.
Central gesture
The room separates into layers and settles back into place.

04 The interface

This portfolio’s kit has no mockup of this page; the published prototype shows the full interface.

The page was conceived as a single scene that unfolds as you scroll, with the content always readable without relying on the animation.

Open published prototype (opens in a new tab)

05 The motion

  1. 01 Room ready
  2. 02 Layers
  3. 03 Back in place

The room appears ready; as you scroll, ceiling, walls, furniture, rug and floor come apart; a cyan trail runs across the details and everything settles back before the next section.

06 Josean’s role

Visual direction and a layered space.
